excerpt.zh:
[from.GetName]无法继续担任方舟舰的外交使节。

代表团将由[event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName]接替管理，他已同意代为执行这项任务。
excerpt.en:
[from.GetName] can no longer serve as the Arkship's diplomatic envoy.

The delegation will continue under [event_target:diplomatic_envoy_leader.GetName], who has agreed to take up the mission in their place.

texts.zh:
[from.GetName]不再继续担任方舟舰的外交使节。

由于没有其他官员可以继续执行任务，合约无法履行。
texts.en:
[from.GetName] can no longer serve as the Arkship's diplomatic envoy.

With no other Official available to carry the mission forward, the Contract cannot be fulfilled.

tooltips.zh: 放弃外交示好，中止这项合约。
tooltips.en: Abandons Diplomatic Overture, ending the Contract.
